sku_skus.grain: One selling SKU; ASTRA-linked selling sizes share one authoritative base stock.
sku_skus.date_basis: All stored DATETIME fields are UTC; reporting calendar is Asia/Jakarta.
sku_skus.source_verified: Reviewed application DDL and read paths; production existence and coverage remain query-time checks.
sku_skus.purpose: Current catalog, selling-unit attributes, COGS, inventory thresholds, purchase MOQ and shipping dimensions.
warnings: Do not SUM current_stock across ASTRA-linked selling SKUs: larger sizes are derived from shared base stock and would double count inventory.
Use jg_astra_stock_map and jg_astra_stock_ratio for the canonical stock-SKU relationship; physical table counts alone are not available-to-sell or forecast demand.
Current COGS is not necessarily historical sale COGS; use effective COGS history and the canonical reporting calculation.
Volume requires unit_id; ASTRA is a stock conversion quantity, not currency.

sku_cogs_history.grain: One COGS change for a SKU.
sku_cogs_history.date_basis: effective_at/effective_until have mixed historical storage: quarterly/period paths use Jakarta local boundaries, while opening/legacy rows can copy UTC recorded_at; recorded_at is UTC.
sku_cogs_history.source_verified: Reviewed application DDL and read paths; production existence and coverage remain query-time checks.
sku_cogs_history.purpose: Saved COGS changes and their effective periods; use the canonical COGS resolver for a sale date.
warnings: Do not add old_price and new_price or apply current price to all history. Larger selling sizes scale base COGS using ASTRA ratio.

effective_at/effective_until do not have a uniform verified timezone across legacy and quarterly/period writers. Do not globally add 7 hours; use the canonical COGS resolver and disclose legacy date uncertainty.

marketplace_order_inventory_allocations.purpose: Existing explicit FIFO allocation ledger, not a sales feed or canonical total P&L.
warnings: This ledger is written only by the explicit POST allocate path; ordinary order reads and lightweight metric reads do not fill missing allocations.
Old consumed_at/created_at values do not imply no recent orders or no recent COGS. Compare the sales mirror and canonical metric COGS/history coverage independently.
Lightweight dashboard gross-margin metrics use current/effective SKU COGS and packing through jg_orders_enrich_for_metrics; they are not a SUM of this allocation ledger.
Reading reporting data never allocates stock, repairs history or refreshes upstream sources.
